entities.summary: The Political Committee of National Liberation, commonly known as the "Mountain Government", was a Communist Party-dominated government established in Greece in 1944 in opposition to both the collaborationist German-controlled government in Athens and to the royal government-in-exile in Cairo who were in support of the collaborationists.
